Product Details: Elevate your drilling precision with the XtraPower HSS Titanium Step Drill Bit Set. Crafted from High-Speed Steel (HSS) with titanium coating, these step drill bits offer enhanced durability and cutting performance. The stepped design allows you to drill multiple hole sizes with a single bit, saving time and ensuring accuracy. Perfect for working with sheet metal, plastic, and wood, these bits create clean, burr-free holes. The titanium coating helps reduce friction and heat build-up during operation, while the HSS construction provides excellent wear resistance. Each bit in this set features precise cutting edges and clearly marked size steps for easy reference. Whether you're a professional tradesperson or a DIY enthusiast, this XtraPower step drill bit set is an essential addition to your toolbox.
